text:
Weak functional malefic = less harm? Nope.

Weakness doesn't take away a graha's energy, only its control, so the harm comes out worse. And judge that weakness by overall ṣaḍbala, not one marker.

Changed how I read weak grahas tbh ..

A bad bhāva doesn't lose its domain. You just suffer it.

Afflicted 6th: disease, debt, enemies. Strong 6th: mastery over disease, lending, even the judge and lawyer. Same house, strength decides which side you're on.

Cleaner than good/bad labels tbh ..
